messages:
maya: Quick check — can we lock in tonight's oncall handoff/triage call agenda? Two active incidents: INC-513 (DB timeouts) and INC-514 (KV cache miss spike). Need escalation lead + infra backup for each, and someone to run the call.

chris: I can take escalation lead for INC-513. I'll start with the DB query plan rollback. @leo can you be infra backup?

leo: Yep, I can be infra backup for both. Will run `kubectl get pods -n inference` and tail logs if needed.

anuja: I'll run the call. Proposed agenda:
1) quick incident status (30m max)
2) owner actions + mitigations
3) decide next-step (rollback / patch / capacity)
4) assign postmortem owners + timeline
5) ops notes (rate limit/hardening)

devon: Add "recent canary deployment checks" to agenda — saw a spike after 22:10 UTC.

sre-bot: Reminder: Oncall handoff + triage call scheduled for 20:00 UTC. Meet: https://meet.redwood.com/triage/20-00
Command snippets:
```
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=redwood --since=15m
redis-cli -h cache.prod.ping info | grep -i evicted_keys
```

maya: attendee list so far: @maya, @chris (esc lead INC-513), @leo (infra), @anuja (call lead), @devon (canary check). Can @sam ops confirm attendance?

sam: I'll join and take notes + follow-ups.

chris: For INC-513 I plan to roll back the last DB index change; ETA 18m. Will post short timeline on thread.

leo: Running quick health check now — `/health` 200, but DB p95 spikes on metrics.

anuja: ok set — I'll start the call at 20:00 sharp and I'll ping this thread with dial-in 5m prior. Anything else?

devon: pls also add "who owns immediate customer comms" to agenda.

maya: Good point — @sam will handle comms unless he opts out.

sam: happy to take comms.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. If anything changes DM me, otherwise see you on call.
